label: AgriSense-Edge Industrial Cyber-Physical Pipeline
info: Industry 4.0 Multi-Depth In-Situ Sensing, FAO-56 Calibration, and Closed-Loop Hysteretic Interlock Pipeline

name: Kaggle Dataset Cycler
Sensor Ingestion Demux
func:
const p = msg.payload || {};
node.status({ fill: "blue", shape: "dot", text: `m10: ${(p.moisture_10cm*100).toFixed(1)}% | T: ${p.air_temperature_c}C` });
return [
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/moisture_10cm', payload: p.moisture_10cm, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/moisture_30cm', payload: p.moisture_30cm, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/moisture_50cm', payload: p.moisture_50cm, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/soil_temp', payload: p.soil_temperature_c, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/weather', payload: { temp: p.air_temperature_c, hum: p.humidity_pct }, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/solar', payload: p.solar_radiation_w_m2, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/rain', payload: p.rainfall_mm_hr, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/hydraulic', payload: { press: p.line_pressure_bar, flow: p.flow_rate_l_min }, raw: p },
  { ...msg, topic: 'sensor/power', payload: { batt: p.battery_voltage_v, solar_ma: p.solar_harvest_ma }, raw: p },
  msg
];

name: 10cm Evaporative Horizon
func: node.status({ fill: msg.payload < 0.18 ? 'red' : 'green', shape: 'dot', text: `${(msg.payload*100).toFixed(1)}% VWC (Surf)` }); return msg;

name: 30cm Rhizosphere Layer
func: node.status({ fill: msg.payload >= 0.32 ? 'blue' : 'green', shape: 'dot', text: `${(msg.payload*100).toFixed(1)}% VWC (Root)` }); return msg;

name: 50cm Sub-Root Percolation
func: node.status({ fill: msg.payload >= 0.35 ? 'red' : 'green', shape: 'dot', text: `${(msg.payload*100).toFixed(1)}% VWC (Drain)` }); return msg;

name: In-Situ Soil RTD Temp
func: node.status({ fill: 'grey', shape: 'dot', text: `${msg.payload.toFixed(1)}C (10cm)` }); return msg;

name: Atmospheric Micro-Climate
func: node.status({ fill: 'grey', shape: 'dot', text: `${msg.payload.temp}C | ${msg.payload.hum}% RH` }); return msg;

name: Pyranometer Solar Flux
func: node.status({ fill: 'yellow', shape: 'dot', text: `${msg.payload} W/m2` }); return msg;

name: Tipping Rain Gauge
func: node.status({ fill: msg.payload > 0 ? 'blue' : 'grey', shape: 'dot', text: `${msg.payload} mm/hr` }); return msg;

name: Hydraulic Pressure & Flow
func: node.status({ fill: 'blue', shape: 'dot', text: `${msg.payload.press} bar | ${msg.payload.flow} L/min` }); return msg;

name: Pod Power & Harvester
func: node.status({ fill: 'green', shape: 'dot', text: `${msg.payload.batt}V | ${msg.payload.solar_ma} mA` }); return msg;
